conditions.build: Explicit -PsettlementProfile=sandbox; production remains the default dedicated-only build

change.summary: Separate standalone Settlements artifact from dedicated-only production so sandbox bell placement reaches founding and existing emerald payment selection.

modifiers.before: Copied production artifact does not register gameplay listeners on the physical client and rejects integrated-server authority.
modifiers.after: Explicit sandbox build registers existing listeners and enables logical integrated authority and native HOME/birth/pat hooks. Default production retains dedicated-only authority and hooks. Currency remains actual jem_economy detection, otherwise physical emeralds.

cause.owner: JEMSettlements build profile and runtime authority

rationale.purpose: Make the explicitly requested sandbox Settlements copy usable without re-enabling SMP gameplay in ordinary singleplayer clients.
rationale.decision_source: User reports bell placement opens nothing after copying test jem Settlements into jem sandbox and reiterates emerald fallback requirement.
rationale.codex_choices: Separate compile-time source profiles and sandbox output/classifier; preserve canonical payment implementation and production distribution.

introduced.summary: Fix sandbox artifact boundary; gameplay acceptance pending.

history.summary: Trace absent bell screen through missing physical-client listener registration and integrated authority rejection; currency selection is downstream and already supports emeralds.

notes: Sandbox-only installation; no ManagedPack, ordinary Server, stable profile or baseline change required.
Bundled Identity/Core are retained; Economy and Professions are not added.
unresolved: User confirmation of founding screen and emerald purchases remains pending; no gameplay launch or automated tests.
